articles.title: Moment Factory Unveils Upgraded Augmented Games Ahead of IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: Moment Factory is showcasing a refreshed version of its Augmented Games interactive attraction at IAAPA Expo 2026, building on 35-plus playfield deployments and over 2 million sessions played worldwide. The update focuses on making the platform more intuitive and future-ready, responding directly to operator feedback and rising demand for competitive socializing attractions. FEC operators looking for low-staff, high-engagement interactive attractions should take note of this proven and evolving product.

articles.title: Miraculous: Land of Heroes FEC Chain Planned for U.S. Rollout Starting 2028
articles.summary: Miraculous Corp and ActivNation have announced a partnership to develop a new chain of family entertainment centers under the Miraculous: Land of Heroes brand, targeting U.S. locations beginning in 2028. The concept will feature immersive entertainment, interactive attractions, and themed experiences tied to the globally popular Miraculous animated franchise. This signals growing momentum for IP-driven FEC development and is worth watching for operators and investors eyeing branded entertainment formats.

articles.title: Early Supplier Coordination Is the Key to Smoother FEC Construction
articles.summary: A veteran construction professional with experience on Topgolf, Andretti, Puttshack, F1 Arcade, and Pinstack projects outlines how aligning attraction suppliers early in the design phase prevents costly last-minute changes to walls, utilities, and timelines. When supplier requirements arrive late, operators end up solving construction problems instead of focusing on hiring and training. This practical guide offers directly actionable advice for any FEC operator planning a new build or significant renovation.

articles.title: Lucky Strike Entertainment Posts $302.6M Revenue in Q3 2026, Remains in the Red
articles.summary: Lucky Strike Entertainment reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $302.64 million but recorded a loss of $0.21 per share, offering a real-time snapshot of financial performance for one of the largest FEC and bowling-entertainment operators in North America. The results highlight ongoing pressure on profitability in the competitive socializing and entertainment center space. Investors and FEC operators can benchmark their own performance against these figures.

articles.title: FACE Amusement Group and Betson Enterprises Team Up for Guy Fieri's Downtown Flavortown Arcade
articles.summary: FACE Amusement Group has partnered with Betson Enterprises to deliver the arcade and amusement gaming experience inside Guy Fieri's Downtown Flavortown entertainment dining concept in Johnson City, Tennessee. The deal illustrates the growing trend of celebrity-branded entertainment dining venues incorporating full-scale arcade operations managed by specialized FEC operators. For operators and suppliers, this partnership model offers a template for entering non-traditional venue formats.

articles.title: ESAC Uses Shanghai WUNPARK Case Study to Outline 2027 FEC Design Trends
articles.summary: Design and planning firm ESAC has published analysis of the Shanghai WUNPARK project to identify emerging FEC design trends for 2027, focusing on the shift from attraction-mix venues to integrated social destinations. The case study examines how layout, programming, and experience design can drive dwell time and repeat visitation. FEC operators and designers planning new builds or renovations should review these findings for forward-looking guidance.

articles.title: Betson Named Exclusive North American Distributor of Andamiro's Mickey & Friends Coin Pusher
articles.summary: Betson Enterprises has secured exclusive North American distribution rights for Andamiro's new Mickey & Friends six-player coin pusher, which will debut at IAAPA Expo 2026 in Orlando. The Disney-licensed title brings strong IP recognition to the coin pusher category, a consistently reliable revenue driver in arcade and FEC environments. Operators attending IAAPA should add this product to their must-see list.

articles.title: Premiere Cinemas Expanding at South Plains Mall with Large New Family Entertainment Center
articles.summary: Premiere Cinemas is adding a major family entertainment center to its South Plains Mall location, reflecting the broader industry trend of cinema operators diversifying into multi-attraction FEC formats to drive foot traffic and revenue. The expansion represents a significant bet on the combined cinema-plus-FEC model at a time when traditional movie exhibition faces headwinds. Operators and landlords watching the evolution of mall-based entertainment should follow this development.

articles.title: Launch Family Entertainment Center Opens New Location in Denton, Texas
articles.summary: Launch Family Entertainment has opened a new venue in Denton, Texas, continuing the trampoline park and multi-attraction FEC brand's regional expansion. The opening adds to the competitive landscape for indoor entertainment in the Dallas-Fort Worth metro area. Operators in the region and those tracking Launch's growth strategy will want to note the new market entry.

articles.title: Viewpoint Videos Scales Souvenir Video System to 50 Countries, Targets FEC and Attraction Operators
articles.summary: UK-based Viewpoint Videos has grown its plug-and-play souvenir video system to operate across more than 50 countries, serving karting, adventure, and ride attraction venues with an automated, low-staffing capture-and-sell solution. Guests can purchase personalized videos directly to their phones moments after their experience, creating a secondary revenue stream that requires minimal operator involvement. FEC operators running go-karts, climbing walls, zip lines, or similar activities should evaluate this as an add-on revenue opportunity.

articles.title: Christie to Present Projection Mapping Spotlight Session at IAAPA Expo 2026
articles.summary: Christie will host a dedicated Spotlight Session on projection mapping technology at IAAPA Expo 2026, with its technologies also featured across multiple partner booths on the show floor. Projection mapping is increasingly used in FEC environments for immersive theming, interactive floors, and attraction enhancement. Operators interested in upgrading the visual and experiential quality of their venues should attend this session.

articles.title: Dynamic Creatures and Sixth Wall Partner to Bring Hasbro Interactive Robots to Location-Based Entertainment
articles.summary: Dynamic Creatures and Sixth Wall Studio have announced a collaboration to develop Hasbro-branded interactive robots for location-based entertainment venues, combining Sixth Wall's character AI with Dynamic Creatures' mobile robotic platforms. The partnership brings recognizable toy IP into interactive walk-around or attraction formats that could appeal to FEC operators seeking differentiated character experiences. This is an early signal of how robotics and licensed IP may converge in next-generation FEC attractions.

articles.title: Teamplay Station Comprehensive Entertainment Center Opens in Brunei
articles.summary: A new multi-activity entertainment center branded as Teamplay Station has opened in Brunei, targeting players of all ages with a broad mix of gaming and attractions. The opening reflects ongoing FEC expansion across Southeast Asia as rising middle-class populations and mall-based leisure investment drive demand. Suppliers and operators with international growth ambitions should monitor this region's accelerating market development.

articles.title: New Indoor Entertainment Venue with Multiple Activities Planned for Amble, UK
articles.summary: A new indoor entertainment venue offering a range of activities is set to open in Amble, Northumberland, adding to the growing number of multi-attraction indoor leisure destinations emerging in smaller UK markets. The trend underscores how FEC-style concepts are penetrating beyond major metropolitan areas into secondary and tertiary towns. UK operators and suppliers should note the continued geographic spread of the indoor entertainment format.

articles.title: California's Great America Confirms 2027 as Its Final Operating Season
articles.summary: Cedar Fair-era park California's Great America in Santa Clara has confirmed that 2027 will be its final season, ending nearly 50 years of operation at the site. The closure will free up a significant parcel of land in the San Francisco Bay Area and may represent a redevelopment opportunity for entertainment or mixed-use concepts. FEC investors and developers should watch the site's future use, as repurposing of legacy amusement park land has increasingly attracted FEC and entertainment district proposals.

articles.title: Six Flags Appoints Adam Boal as Chief Procurement Officer
articles.summary: Six Flags has named Adam Boal as its new Chief Procurement Officer, bringing experience overseeing billions in corporate spend and managing supplier partnerships at scale. The appointment signals continued investment in operational efficiency and supply chain management at one of North America's largest theme park and entertainment operators. Suppliers to large park groups should be aware of potential shifts in procurement strategy and vendor relationships under new leadership.

articles.title: WhiteWater Appoints Michael Dalzell as VP of Global Marketing
articles.summary: WhiteWater, a global leader in water attraction manufacturing, has hired Michael Dalzell as Vice President of Global Marketing, bringing over 20 years of brand and commercial growth experience from companies including The North Face. The appointment reflects the company's focus on strengthening its global brand presence as competition in the water attraction and waterpark equipment market intensifies. Suppliers and park operators that work with WhiteWater should anticipate stronger marketing and partnership outreach from the company.

articles.title: Wisconsin Pub Installs Indoor Golf Simulators to Drive Winter Revenue
articles.summary: A pub in Beloit, Wisconsin has added indoor golf simulators as a seasonal revenue strategy during winter months when outdoor activity declines. The move illustrates how small hospitality operators are adopting FEC-style attractions to extend dwell time and generate incremental spend. FEC operators can benchmark this diversification approach as golf simulation continues to grow as an accessible add-on attraction.

articles.title: Memoir Creative Appoints Kevin Kreczko as Chief Growth Officer
articles.summary: Memoir Creative, a full-service experience design and fabrication studio with over 40 staff and a 50,000-square-foot production facility, has named Kevin Kreczko as Chief Growth Officer and is expanding its client services. The firm works across themed entertainment, museums, and location-based experience projects relevant to FEC design and build. Operators and developers seeking fabrication and design partners should note Memoir's expanded capabilities.

articles.title: Vikings: The Immersive Experience Demonstrates Viability of Touring Cultural Attractions Without a Collection
articles.summary: The Vikings: The Immersive Experience touring production shows how a fully dramatic, ticketed immersive attraction can be built around a cultural theme without museum objects or a permanent venue, with Vienna tickets starting at 25.90 euro. The format is relevant to FEC and LBE operators exploring pop-up or touring immersive experiences as a flexible revenue model. Operators considering temporary or touring attraction formats should study this production's creative and commercial approach.

articles.title: Creative Problem-Solving in LBE: How Mad Studio Delivers Surprising Practical Effects
articles.summary: Creative technology studio Mad describes its process for delivering seemingly impossible guest-facing effects, including an upward-flowing water illusion, within the real constraints of budget, safety, and high-traffic venue operation. The piece is a useful reminder that creative ambition and operational practicality are not mutually exclusive in FEC and LBE design. Operators and designers working on new attractions or renovations will find the mindset described here applicable to their own projects.

articles.title: Madison Approves $11.74M in TIF Financing for Retail and Dining Development Including Entertainment
articles.summary: The city of Madison has approved up to $11.741 million in tax increment financing borrowing to support a retail, dining, and entertainment development project. TIF mechanisms like this are increasingly used to anchor mixed-use developments that include FEC or entertainment components, making this a relevant case study for operators and developers seeking public financing support. FEC developers exploring public-private partnerships should track this approval as a model for similar municipal deals.

articles.title: Could Closing Parks Help Six Flags Improve Guest Experience and Financial Performance?
articles.summary: An analysis examines whether Six Flags' strategy of closing or consolidating underperforming parks could ultimately benefit the company's overall guest experience quality and financial health following its merger with Cedar Fair. The question is directly relevant to the broader theme park and large-scale FEC industry as operators weigh portfolio rationalization against market coverage. Investors and large multi-site FEC operators should follow Six Flags' restructuring decisions closely.

articles.title: Storyland Studios: How a Story-First Design Philosophy Shapes LBE Venue Success
articles.summary: Storyland Studios co-founders describe how grounding location-based entertainment design in narrative purpose from the outset produces stronger guest experiences and more cohesive venues. The studio's work spans theme parks, FEC-adjacent attractions, and branded experiences, drawing on deep Disney Imagineering heritage. FEC operators and designers planning new concepts will find the story-first framework a useful counterpoint to attraction-led development approaches.

articles.title: Shanghai Disney Enchanted Star Hotel Opens December 16 with 400 Rooms and Immersive Disney Theming
articles.summary: Shanghai Disney Resort is opening its third themed hotel on December 16, featuring 400 rooms with interactive Disney artwork, Art Nouveau design inspired by early 20th-century Shanghai, and direct views of Enchanted Storybook Castle. The property demonstrates how major entertainment destinations are deepening guest immersion through highly themed overnight experiences to extend stays and increase per-guest spend. FEC and entertainment resort operators can draw inspiration from Disney's approach to experiential hotel design as a revenue-driving complement to attractions.
